messages.author: f0cbf2f11e791de3
messages.subject: plotProbe of semTools
parts:
Hi, dear lavaan community, 

I am using semTools package to create latent interactions and produce simple slopes. I have used plotProbe() function to plot the interaction. Now I need the plot to be publication ready (according to APA). I have been searching about this, but without any luck yet. 

Could you please help me by letting me know how to be able to edit the plots in easier ways? 

Thank you very much and really appreciate your help. 

Best regards, 
Tarek

messages.author: 5d4f9e7f97c21008
messages.subject: Re: plotProbe of semTools
parts:
Hi Tarek,

Currently plotProbe() uses base R graphics. You can add whatever graphical parameters to plotProbe using base R graphics (the ... argument in plotProbe is where you specify additional graphical parameters. If you search for "base R plotting" you'll fine lots of tutorials on this topic. It's not ideal, and at some point I'd like to switch the function to ggplot, but that's not going to happen in the next couple of months.

Alex

messages.subject: Re: plotProbe of semTools
parts: Another possible suggestion: you could also try using the somewhat recent package "modsem". It uses lavaan-syntax and you can further customize your plots with ggplot. Also, you may find this paper interesting about visualizing interactions/moderation: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/32309961/

Many thanks for your helpful comments.

Just a small question though, will the Excel template developed by Jeremy Dawson be appropriate for latent interaction models? I have tried this and the plot seems consistent to the interaction results and to what plotProbe shows.  

Thanks and always appreciate your help. 

Best,
